# Lab View v2 Phase 1 implementation report

Model: Codex, GPT-6 family as identified by the runtime instructions. The precise model ID and API reasoning-effort setting are not exposed. Effort: sustained test-first implementation with independent context, frontend and browser-measurement work.

Brief: results/labviz_v2_codex_brief.md. Binding design: docs/LABVIZ_V2_SPEC.md (v2). Operator ruling: D-C10r-labviz-2.

The implementation and generated artifacts are written. Final tests: 49/53 passing; 4 browser-dependent failures remain. Browser rendering, screenshots and interaction measurements are **UNVERIFIED**. This report gives no reviewer verdict and does not claim Phase 1 acceptance. All context framing remains DRAFT for the program session's review.

After the operator reported the tmux server hang around 02:16 MDT and restart, the worktree/branch and the on-disk report, source digests, complete test output, jq proof and unchanged-rebuild audit were checked again. They persisted intact. The operator reconfirmed that no GPU job is live. A post-restart Playwright rerun again exited 2 before rendering any page; the latest diagnostic below records that attempt. Earlier wall-time measurements remain preserved.

## Implemented behavior

The home page is the connections map. Map, Science lines, Runs, Inside the model, and Learn & evaluations share navigation, status, breadcrumb, context framing, evidence tier, selected run and URL state. Detailed cards load through classic line scripts, including file URLs. Model enhancement is a classic-script entry point with optional pinned three.js 0.160.0 and an HTML/2D fallback.

The recorded reader emits 1537 typed cards from 372 surveyed JSON sources, including 54 registry documentary cards, historical CORPUS/model findings and log observations. The generated context graph has 361 nodes and 586 typed edges. Context resolution follows result paths, documentary headers, the chosen registry decision, then unknown/candidates; D1 is not assigned to B1-size-term. Namespaces distinguish experiments, hypotheses, runbook tracks and C10 arms. Registry status now stays separate from DRAFT era framing.

Badges preserve roles and sourced labels. C10V binding B·A7 is 12/72, goal 61, NULL; controls carry no goal or binding-label chip. C10W oracle P1·A7 is 70/72 with the verbatim oracle class, a null final label and the configuration-only interim chip. C10U F_r0_mint1_s0 uses the binding replicate-F reader's LEAD; its replica has a replica note. R5 retains CHARACTERIZATION and its per-arm rates; G6.1 retains the registry's own status and 100 record rows plus three rungs.

Recorded booleans, not derived thresholds, supply gate glyphs. The contract tests reproduce all 71 available booleans: C10V 15, C10U 49, C10W 7. Missing/UNDERFIT readings yield no invented judgement. Oracle G4 includes the canonical plus 20 training frames; G6 uses the recorded U.A7_coined_coined reference; G7 uses the matched shuffled control.

Per-fact panels preserve subject, answer, question order, hit-kind, generated text where recorded, all original fact diagnostics, C10V selector diagnostics/target IDs and C10W answer-word splits plus the 20 T01–T20 training phrasings. Question transcription is checked as text and bound by SHA, role and order. Missing tokenizer piece text remains a named Phase 2a gap. C10U teacher-forced strips are distinct from free answers.

Applied write bars use the complete absolute-norm population and preserve full precision. The common maximum is 113.7967300415039; B·A7 layer 8 is 16.31455421447754. B0·A7 colours layer 8 only while outlining configured layers 4–8. Predicted, injection, telemetry, replay and sandbox values do not enter this ruler. Relative-size and ratio diagnostics retain their own recorded units and are not placed on the absolute ruler.

Compare joins subjects and checks population, answers, question templates and scoring kind. C10V's map is 24×5 with first/repeat margins and B's exact recorded Spearman −0.3162875387734472. Training shows 40 recorded losses and 400 recorded step times, without intermediate answers. Parts/wiring preserve the specified frozen-training/restored-base wording. The event scrubber keeps timestamped UTC ordering separate from untimed loss/log markers; it infers no event time from filenames, durations or mtimes.

Saved summaries use deterministic SVG/Pillow for the production 1,423 SVG/PNG pairs. This replaces per-card Matplotlib work to keep the model-free builder bounded; Matplotlib remains for the retained regression fixtures. The active image manifest stores pixel width and every text size. Production summaries use 14px text at width 561px (14.973262px at the specified 600px display width); the uncropped 9pt Matplotlib fixture measures 14.705882px at width 600, while the negative 6pt fixture measures 9.803922px. These are source/metadata checks, not rendered-browser measurements. Retained, unlinked v1 images were not deleted.

## Execution boundary and source preservation

Before Python, the operator explicitly confirmed that no GPU coordinator, stage or experiment driver was live or pending; P2 was HALTED. Process inspection is denied in this sandbox, so the report relies on that current confirmation, not a fabricated ps/pgrep result. Python ran only through the exact authorized unittest and builder commands. No model, torch, tokenizer, vocabulary, adapter or tensor file was loaded or opened. Only the permitted Qwen2.5-3B snapshot config.json was read. Production modules start no child process; only test code invokes jq. The 8765 server was not started, probed or curled. There were no commits, canonical science updates or writes to C10Z files.

The preserved server SHA is c90afb9ce1bd8c3b54af95f4534f055404587a0105045e931ee34d6cb9a05a4b; its entry point and the two gate-exempt command lines remain unchanged. Read-only source audit: 439 initial input hashes checked. 2 inputs differ from their initial snapshot: docs/c10_scoreboard.json, EXPERIMENT_RUNBOOK.md. This task made no writes to either file; they are shared program inputs. No global unchanged-worktree claim is made. Final cards hash the source bytes used by the build. Full before/after evidence is source-preservation.json.

One early Playwright probe used Playwright's default macOS temporary-profile location before TMPDIR was supplied. Its launch failed and Playwright reported automatic profile cleanup. This transient scratch-boundary mistake is disclosed; subsequent probes and the final runner used /private/tmp/labviz-review/test-tmp. Package/browser/cache writes were confined to the authorized scratch roots. No out-of-scope cleanup was performed.

## jq and leaf verification

Before implementation, jq enumerated every available path in 373 inspected JSON files (1,689,155 paths); jq-paths.json records each file hash, path and type. The final comprehensive proof checks **47802 distinct used JSON paths**, 162408 sourced-leaf occurrences, 30512 document/log quote occurrences and 420 unique card-source hashes. Every checked JSON value equals its card leaf at full recorded precision. The proof includes cards, scale operands and graph JSON citations. Missing/mismatched paths: **0**. No binding spec data path was unresolved.

An additional proof caught malformed quoted-root model-catalog paths. graph-path-red.txt retains that failing jq output; _json_path now emits .["model"].status, the context resolver accepts that canonical syntax, and test 11 checks graph JSON paths. Log quote checking uses Python splitlines semantics, including carriage-return progress lines; a first LF-only checker produced false mismatches, verified by a positive-control source line before correcting the checker. No source log was changed.

The exact file/path list and hashes are in jq-complete-proof.json and transcribed below. jq-leaves.json records the unittest's family-spanning sample cross-check (at least 50 leaves and all path grammar forms).

## Build budget and unchanged rebuild

Both runs wrapped the unchanged entry point with /usr/bin/time -l:

```sh
/usr/bin/time -l .venv/bin/python -B tools/labviz/build.py
```

MPLCONFIGDIR and TMPDIR were set to the authorized scratch directories without changing the Python arguments. The cold cache was moved to a retained review artifact so every active picture was regenerated.

| Run | time -l wall seconds | Builder elapsed seconds | Peak RSS bytes (getrusage) | Picture calls | Budget | Measured comparison |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cold | 42.97 | 42.113353 | 734380032 | 1423 | ≤120 s; ≤2 GB | Within numeric limits |
| Warm | 9.77 | 9.403155 | 731398144 | 0 | ≤15 s; ≤1.5 GB | Within numeric limits |


Warm audit: 5226 files/link entries checked; changed bytes or mtimes: 0; renderer calls: 0. The retained site/runs link points only to ../runs inside results/labviz.

/usr/bin/time printed elapsed/user/sys, then failed its kernel accounting query with "sysctl kern.clockrate: Operation not permitted" and returned 1 after the builder completed. Therefore complete time -l RSS fields are unavailable. Peak RSS above is the builder's resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss, in bytes on Darwin; these are supplemental measurements, not invented time -l fields. Logs retain the error.

An earlier unchanged warm run took 19.43 s wall (18.764301 s builder elapsed; 734527488 bytes peak RSS), exceeded 15 s, changed no outputs and rendered no pictures. It is retained in warm-slow-build.txt / warm-slow-time.txt / warm-slow-check.json. The later run was repeated after local verification jobs finished; no causal claim about the earlier delay is made.

## Design self-check (measurements only)

Node /opt/homebrew/bin/node v26.8.2 and npm 11.19.1 were probed. npm install playwright failed with ENOTFOUND registry.npmjs.org. Chromium/WebKit install attempts failed with ENOTFOUND cdn.playwright.dev / playwright.download.prss.microsoft.com. The fallback copied existing Playwright 1.61.1 packages to /private/tmp/labviz-review/node_modules and cached Chromium headless build 1243 to /private/tmp/labviz-review/ms-playwright; its --version returned Google Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12. Protocol compatibility remains UNVERIFIED. WebKit 2311 is absent. Full attempts are /private/tmp/labviz-review/install-errors.json.

Every npm/Playwright command used npm_config_cache=/private/tmp/labviz-review/npm-cache and PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/private/tmp/labviz-review/ms-playwright. Final runner additionally used TMPDIR=/private/tmp/labviz-review/test-tmp. It opened only the requested file URL, and exited 2 before any page was rendered: Chromium's MachPortRendezvousServer bootstrap_check_in was denied (1100), ending in SIGTRAP; WebKit's executable was missing. Latest diagnostic: results/labviz/review/20261008T083553978Z/measure.json.

Requested engines/viewports: Chromium and WebKit at 1440×900, 390×844, 360×780, 844×390 and the 1440×900 200% case, over the required map/focus, science lines, selected C10V/G6.1 run, compare, 2D/3D model, Mistral, learn and evaluation screens. ## Fix round 1

Completed at 2026-10-08T10:21:21.716Z. Review addressed: `results/labviz_v2_phase1_design_review.md` (FIX-FIRST). The baseline used is `results/labviz/review/20261008T084543647Z/measure.json` and its 160 screenshots; the stale `20261008T084237572Z` directory was excluded.

All 10 BLOCKING fixes and all 14 ADVISORY fixes are implemented. Final verification: **58/58 Python tests**, **62/62 Node tests**, **4/4 checks using generated evidence through the actual app renderer**, and **1,541 indexed cards / 422 cited source files with zero missing copies or hash mismatches**. This records implementation and CPU evidence, not a post-fix design-review PASS. **Browser acceptance remains UNVERIFIED**: the provisioned Chromium executable failed to launch inside the sandbox, and the browser step was stopped as instructed.

### Constraints and evidence boundary

Before PYTHON-OK, the only Python command executed was the explicitly exempt `.venv/bin/python -B tools/labviz/build.py`. After the user sent PYTHON-OK (expressly not GPU-CLEAR), the CPU suite ran sequentially, without model loads, GPU work or parallel heavy jobs. Node checks were also sequential. No C10Z file was edited. Changes are confined to `tools/labviz/**`, generated `results/labviz/**`, this report, and approved temporary scratch paths. No scientific result, experiment driver, frozen preregistration, CORPUS record or canonical program document was rewritten. No commit was created and no server on port 8765 was started or probed.

The tables below use the review fix-list numbers (1–10 BLOCKING; 11–24 ADVISORY), not its separate 17 acceptance-criterion numbers. “Tested” means the indicated source, data or DOM-adapter assertion passed. A DOM adapter does not measure layout, browser events, font rendering, touch geometry or screenshots.

### Criterion → change → evidence

| Review fix | Implemented change | Evidence and practical limit |
|---|---|---|
| **1 BLOCKING · stale frame / criterion 2** | `app.js` chooses the frame from the current view: Map and its focus; Learn and its era; model history and its model; Lines and its line. Stale D1 or Mistral state cannot label another view. | Frontend tests cover Learn after Mistral, focused Map after D1, and route ownership. The generated-render proof exercises actual Map and D1 output. Browser screenshots UNVERIFIED. |
| **2 BLOCKING · prose / criterion 4** | `style.css` caps prose, captions and caveats at `68ch`. | Frontend CSS assertions pass. Chromium’s previous 72ch ≈ 75-character measurement motivated the margin; the new measured character width remains UNVERIFIED. |
| **3 BLOCKING · write contrast / criterion 5** | `.write-mark` uses `#7a5ca0` on `#101721`. | The Node test computes the actual authored colors and requires mark/track ≥3:1 and text ≥4.5:1; mark contrast is approximately 3.31:1. Final browser compositing UNVERIFIED. |
| **4 BLOCKING · D1 caption / criterion 6** | `context.py` gives `corpus:22` a typed question from the deciding-variable sentence in CORPUS/22 and the cited measure “held-out same-relation read corruption vs concentration”; `app.js` renders these fields. | Context tests fail on the old missing fields and pass on the new data; Python tests validate typed provenance; generated-render proof shows the real D1 question and measure. No scientific source was edited. |
| **5 BLOCKING · C10 status + shared D1 path / criterion 7** | (a) `cond:C10.status` is the actual sourced F1 status cell (`docs/F1_DETERMINATION.md:71`), separate from “Framing review: draft”. The focus panel shows its first status sentence, with the full cited cell in details. (b) D1-shared nodes come before decisions and visibly say “shared with D1”. (c) `review.mjs` follows `[data-shared-with="corpus:22"]`, records panel status, and rejects empty/DRAFT science status. The real node id retains `layer:Write Engine` capitalization. | Context, frontend and harness positive/negative tests pass. Generated Map output contains science status and a visible D1-shared link before run-index loading. Actual ≤4-tap browser path UNVERIFIED. |
| **6 BLOCKING · greyscale / criterion 12** | Connected map nodes carry “● connected”; dimmed nodes say “not on this line’s path” and have dashed/hatched styling. | Frontend assertions cover both DOM words and CSS patterns. Post-fix greyscale screenshot UNVERIFIED. |
| **7 BLOCKING · select targets / criterion 14** | Custom selects use `-webkit-appearance:none`, `appearance:none`, a 44px minimum, chevron image and right padding. | Frontend CSS assertions pass. The fix targets the native WebKit select behavior in the baseline; actual WebKit 44×44 geometry UNVERIFIED. |

Final 360/390px scroll width UNVERIFIED. |
